GTA 6 details you probably missed from the previews and Extended Look:

- Jason and Lucia will get bags under their eyes if they don’t sleep enough
- If they don’t sleep for a couple of days, the regens of stamina and health won’t be as quick but the walking gait won’t be affected
- It’s the first game to implement bed covers as Jason realistically gets into bed, pulls back the covers next Lucia sleeping and sluggishly climbs into bed
- There’s an app called Peekhole (parody of Onlyfans) and an app called Ranter (parody of Yelp)
- Handbrake button has moved to X/A because L1/LB and R1/RB are now used for shooting while driving
- There’s a vehicle menu that lets you open a convertible roof, open the trunk and more
- You can use the car’s indicators like turning right or left
- L3 is used for sprinting instead of tapping X and you can control the default movement speed
- During a robbery, unarmed NPCs will try to snatch the gun out of your hand and there’s a quick time event to stop them
- You can encounter streamers who will stop you for an interview asking for advice similar to TikTokers who stop people on the street and ask “What do you do for a living?”, and you can choose to respond in a rude or nice way
- There’s a rush hour in the game where you’ll see increased traffic
- You can hide in the car’s trunk or hide bodies
- You can order food from a drive-thru
- The map is so big that players won’t explore all of it just by playing through the story: “We don’t have time to take you everywhere"
